actions: Read existing two source blobs and parse AST navigation only; no original guard execution, native compile/workload, checkout/index change, commit/ref or workflow operation.
algorithm_findings: load_registry checks its fixed digest and identities, not current checkout HEAD identity.
reconstruct reads fixed PRODUCT and REVIEW blobs, validates the declared complete product/delta/validation maps, and compares the relevant current files to the fixed source bytes.
main checks current product bytes and tracked inventory plus current validation inventory and exact CI selector. It does not assert HEAD equals PRODUCT, REVIEW, or M2.
verify_current_history checks each protected historical path and its bytes; extra unrelated documentation/artifact files do not themselves change those protected bytes.
The fixed review record at REVIEW_PATH and the admitted old historical inputs must remain present and exact. Sparse omissions still cause an actual guard failure and must not be treated as a pass.
corrected_scope: A documentation/archive-only reconciliation that retains the exact M2 admitted source and validation domains may retain M2 unchanged verifier and registry pins and execute the original v15 on the resulting complete checkout. A changed HEAD alone does not require new PRODUCT/REVIEW pins. No prospective pass is claimed.
future_LP_distinction: Adding LP changes real product and validation inputs; that future composition cannot keep M2 pins merely because the present archive/docs reconciliation can. Previous LP map/feature composition design remains a design requiring exact applicable source admission.

also_require: Original exact CI selector/P7 engineering workflow constraints
Original fixed source review bytes at the pinned path
No product/validation added, removed or altered outside original inventories
Original v15 actual execution succeeds on the resulting view

prior_overstatement: Neither old set of pins can certify a newly composed commit. Bind the actual future product/review/guards via the original admission workflow and run original v15; no predicates should change.
